newsitem.title: UK: LME copper edges higher in slow late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper edges higher in slow late trading.

text.p: Copper prices crept slightly higher in late inter-office trading on Wednesday, but vulnerable nickel lost ground.
Three months London Metal Exchange (LME) copper was indicated at $2,534/$2,537 at 1800 GMT, compared to $2,531 at the afternoon kerb close.
Cash to threes backwardation also widened by about $5 to $75/$80.
The other metals barely budged with the exception of nickel. It slid to $7,250/$7,270 versus $7,280 after failing to recover convincingly from Tuesday's sharp sell-off.
